vulnerability_analysis: The burn() function incorrectly compares the burn amount against _rOwned (reflection amount) instead of converting to token amount. When burning 1 wei, it burns 1 reflection unit (worth much less than 1 token) but subtracts 1 token from _tTotal. The mint() function also incorrectly adds the same amount to both _tTotal and _rOwned without considering the reflection rate, allowing the attacker to mint many more tokens than intended.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner (as required). 2. Call burn(1) to burn minimal reflection amount but reduce total supply. 3. Call mint(attacker, large_amount) to mint tokens at an inflated rate due to reflection/token conversion mismatch. 4. Profit from the increased balance.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the contract owner. 2. Record initial balance. 3. Call burn(1) on the target contract. 4. Call mint(attacker, 1_000_000 * 1e18) on the target contract. 5. Verify final balance is significantly higher than initial.
